blocks.value: Whether you use Zerodha, Groww, Upstox or another broker, most trading apps have a very similar layout.
Imagine This: Every smartphone looks a little different, but almost all have contacts, messages, settings and a camera. Trading apps follow the same idea.
You'll usually see Watchlists, Holdings, Positions, Orders, Funds, Portfolio and your Profile section.
Your Watchlist helps you track stocks without buying them immediately.
Spend a few days exploring the app before making your first investment.
